viewed: Every catalogued still was opened, and every APNG was opened at its first frame, on 2026-11-10. lookingAt is the gaze in that picture (left/right = the viewer's screen left/right). facing is the body direction when it differs from a straight front stance.

height.courseAge: Grade 1 / story year 0 (the current year-01 art).
height.twins: Bora and Sreyneang have baselineAge 6 in process/cast/cast.json. Heights use WHO Child Growth Standards (2006/2007) height-for-age medians at 6.0 years: 116 cm (boys), 115 cm (girls). Marked estimated: true because the baseline is "about 6" at official entrance, not a birthday.
height.others: No baseline age is recorded for anyone else. Height is estimated from the year-01 relative_scale in exports/cast-year-01/tools/chars.json (also in manifest.json), anchored to Bora: heightCm = round(116 × scale / 0.7).
